ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which day begins the week in the Arabic list? (1 mark)
   A. al-khamiis
   B. al-ahad
   C. as-sabt
   D. al-jumuʿa

2. Which Arabic word means "ear"? (1 mark)
   A. رَقَبَةٌ
   B. أُذُنٌ
   C. شَعْرٌ
   D. جِسْمٌ

3. Which Arabic word means "chair"? (1 mark)
   A. سَرِيرٌ
   B. حَدِيقَةٌ
   C. كُرْسِيٌّ
   D. غُرْفَةٌ

4. What does the Arabic sentence الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The cat is under the bed.
   B. The lamp is above the table.
   C. The pen is in the bag.
   D. The book is on the table.

5. What does qawiyy mean? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. new
   C. strong
   D. small

6. Which of these letters does NOT join to the letter after it? (1 mark)
   A. ن (nuun)
   B. ر (raa)
   C. ب (baa)
   D. س (siin)

7. How is the syllable بِي read? (1 mark)
   A. bi
   B. bay
   C. bii
   D. buu

8. Which sound does the Arabic letter س make? (1 mark)
   A. j as in jug
   B. t as in tap
   C. kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   D. s as in sun

9. Which Arabic word means "party"? (1 mark)
   A. شَمْعَةٌ
   B. أُغْنِيَةٌ
   C. حَفْلَةٌ
   D. تَفَضَّلْ

10. Which Arabic sentence means "I write with my hand." (1 mark)
   A. أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي
   B. أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي
   C. أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي
   D. أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي

11. What does the Arabic sentence أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is cold.
   B. The weather is rainy.
   C. I plant a tree.
   D. The weather is hot.

12. What does the Arabic sentence عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The friends are at the party.
   B. On the table there is a cake.
   C. This is a party.
   D. Above the table there is a balloon.

13. Which sentence gives your own name? (1 mark)
   A. maa ismuka?
   B. ismii Ahmad
   C. kayfa haaluka?
   D. maʿa s-salaama

14. How is the Arabic word أَمْسِ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. al-ithnayn
   B. al-yawm
   C. al-jumuʿa
   D. amsi

15. When you read a picture, what should you look at first? (1 mark)
   A. Only the words
   B. The whole picture
   C. Only the colours
   D. Only the corners

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: at-taawilatu Sagiira (2 marks)

17. Spell the word باب by naming the letters in order, and give its meaning. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Describe a game you can play with a partner to practise the position words. (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into English: aakulu l-khubza (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: haadhihi ummii (2 marks)

21. Give three tips that help a speaker to use tone and pace well. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — al-ahad
   The Arabic week begins with al-ahad, Sunday.

2. B — أُذُنٌ
   أُذُنٌ (udhun) means ear.

3. C — كُرْسِيٌّ
   كُرْسِيٌّ (kursii) means chair.

4. B — The lamp is above the table.
   الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila) means: The lamp is above the table.

5. C — strong
   qawiyy means strong.

6. B — ر (raa)
   raa joins only to the letter before it. So do alif, daal, dhaal, zaay and waaw.

7. C — bii
   The letter yaa after a kasra makes the vowel long, so بِي is bii.

8. D — s as in sun
   The letter س makes the sound s as in sun.

9. C — حَفْلَةٌ
   حَفْلَةٌ (hafla) means party.

10. A — أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي
   أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي (aktubu bi-yadii) means: I write with my hand.

11. C — I plant a tree.
   أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً (azraʿu shajara) means: I plant a tree.

12. B — On the table there is a cake.
   عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka) means: On the table there is a cake.

13. B — ismii Ahmad
   ismii means 'my name is', so ismii Ahmad means 'My name is Ahmad'.

14. D — amsi
   أَمْسِ is read amsi and means yesterday.

15. B — The whole picture
   First look at the whole picture, then at the details.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: The table is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: baa, alif, baa. It means door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the letters, 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the meaning.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hide a small object. One learner asks ayna l-qalam? The other answers with a sentence such as al-qalamu taHta l-kursii. Then swap.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hiding an object, 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer sentence.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: I eat bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my mother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Speak loudly enough and clearly; speak at a steady speed; pause between sentences; smile when greeting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid tip.
